name: collapsible
useFor: Use for one optional group (search settings under a query, the layers behind a value). Make the trigger the whole row: a 13px label with Mireye's chevron (ArrowRightIcon with head, turned 90 degrees) at the right that turns when open. In a cut-frame panel let the content open at once (see Section). For several sections, use Accordion.
constraints: Animating anything but the content height and the chevron's turn
A chevron that moves on hover
source: Not in Figma: built from the arrow head (UI · Buttons, 442:3) and the cut frame, for a designer's review
title: Collapsible
description: A part that shows and hides in place, opening with its height; the trigger is the row it sits in.
